evidence_for: H4 breakout has acceptance, not a one-bar overshoot: nine consecutive H4 closes sit above the 2544.63 range top with none closing back inside, Always-In long, breakout_mode true (H4 context).

M15 pullback is tight and shallow, not a reversal: bars 110-119 lows are 2621.54, 2627.00, 2629.84, 2628.72, 2631.27, 2632.98, 2625.84, 2627.10, 2625.85, 2625.83 - all above the pause higher low 2618.80 (M15 bar 109 low '2618.8'), so the flag is holding far above the 2544.63 breakout level.
Higher lows keep rising: 2618.80 (M15 bar 109 low) above 2604.75 (M15 bar 87 low '2604.75') above the H4 spike low 2495.82, so the pullback is doing no damage to the bull structure.

The last bars show minimal selling pressure: bars 116-119 have 4-8 point ranges and bar 119 (O2629.57 H2630 L2625.83 C2626) failed to undercut bar 118's low 2625.85, so a stop above 2630 is the standard prior-bar/signal-bar entry (bar 118 closed 2629.75 near its 2630 high in a bull trend) with structural risk to 2618.80.

D1's final bar closes 2632.98, the highest close of its 120-bar window, and the H4 context cites a measured-move context near 2730 from the 2357.18/2358.62 double bottom plus the 2544.63 break, so the structure is not yet at an obvious exhaustion level.
evidence_against: Nearby opposing structure crowds the trigger: the pause's double-touch high is 2658.79 (M15 bars 89 and 90 highs both 2658.79), 28.79 above the 2630 stop, and the 2700.00 buy-climax high (M15 bar 56 H2700.00, C2649.54, tail 50.46) sits just beyond it; D1 lists 2680.00 and 2700.00 as lower highs under the 2771 spike high (D1 bar 90).

The breakout is stalling, not following through: since M15 bar 56's 2700.00 high, 63 M15 bars have moved sideways with descending highs (2658.79 -> 2646.36 -> 2649.83 -> 2636.47 -> 2630.00), i.e. two-sided trading rather than new highs.

Immediate momentum is down and no bull signal bar is present at the trigger: bar 119 closes 2626 near its 2625.83 low, and the final H1 bar (open_time 1789862400000, O2632.98 H2633.05 L2625.83 C2626) is a bear bar closing near its low.

D1 phase is range with the top rejecting: no close above 2771, prior probes at 2680 (D1 bar 111) and 2700 (D1 bar 119) failed below the spike high, and the 2357.18/2358.62 double bottom frames the floor, so this is an upper-range entry rather than a fresh trend entry.

H4 itself flags the pause as a possible final flag: the last four H4 bars (open_times 1789804800000-1789848000000) are small-body bars with a 2700.00 upper tail, and H4's transition condition says a close back below 2544.63 would recast the range-top break as a bull trap.
uncertainty: A tight pause after a buy-climax spike can be either a bull flag or a final flag; the descending M15 highs since bar 56 leave that unresolved.
The entry is a pending stop at 2630, not a filled trade; if price loses 2618.80 first, the flag reads as a failed breakout instead of a continuation.
H4 (trading-range regime, breakout-spike phase) and D1 (range phase with the top rejecting) describe the same bars with different emphasis, so regime confidence is only medium.
